description: Verify AllF-AllG natural fusion proteins in UniProt and plot the co-occurrence/fusion evidence
code:
import requests, json, os, pandas as pd, numpy as np
OUT=os.getcwd(); S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",64)
def uq(q,size=100):
    r=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
            params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,protein_name,organism_name,length,xref_pfam",
                    "format":"tsv","size":size},timeout=120)
    rows=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n")]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows[1:],columns=rows[0])

df=uq("(xref:pfam-PF06545) AND (xref:pfam-PF02629)",size=100)
print("columns:",list(df.columns))
df["Length"]=pd.to_numeric(df["Length"],errors="coerce")
print(df[["Entry","Protein names","Organism","Length"]].head(15).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nn={len(df)} sampled; length min {df.Length.min():.0f}, median {df.Length.median():.0f}, max {df.Length.max():.0f}")
print("AllF alone = 555 aa, AllG alone = 419 aa, sum = 974 aa")
print(f"fusions >= 850 aa: {(df.Length>=850).sum()} of {len(df)}")
df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"table8_allF_allG_fusion_examples.csv"),index=False)

# verify a long one really carries both domains in one chain
long=df[df.Length>=850].head(3)
for e in long.Entry:
    j=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{e}.json",timeout=60).json()
    pf=[(x["id"],[p["value"] for p in x.get("properties",[])][:1]) for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]) if x["database"]=="Pfam"]
    print(f"\n{e} len={j['sequence']['length']} org={j['organism']['scientificName']}")
    print("   Pfam:",pf)

# ---------- figure: co-occurrence / fusion evidence ----------
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
net=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"table5_string_network_allFGHK.csv"))
sub={"fdrA","ylbE","ylbF","ybcF"}
core=net[net.apply(lambda x: {x.preferredName_A,x.preferredName_B}<=sub,axis=1)].copy()
ren={"fdrA":"AllF","ylbE":"AllG","ylbF":"AllH","ybcF":"AllK"}
core["pair"]=core.apply(lambda x: f"{ren[x.preferredName_A]}-{ren[x.preferredName_B]}",axis=1)
core=core.sort_values("score",ascending=False)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ch=["nscore","fscore","pscore","tscore"]
lab={"nscore":"genomic neighbourhood","fscore":"gene fusion","pscore":"phylogenetic co-occurrence","tscore":"text mining"}
x=np.arange(len(core)); w=0.2
for i,c in enumerate(ch):
    axes[0].bar(x+(i-1.5)*w, core[c], width=w, label=lab[c])
axes[0].set_xticks(x); axes[0].set_xticklabels(core.pair,fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_ylabel("STRING channel score"); axes[0].legend(fontsize=7.5)
axes[0].set_title("STRING evidence channels, AllFGHK subunit pairs",fontsize=10,loc="left")
counts=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"table7_domain_fusion_counts.csv"))
counts["n_entries"]=pd.to_numeric(counts["n_entries"])
cc=counts.sort_values("n_entries")
axes[1].barh(np.arange(len(cc)),cc.n_entries,color=["#b03a2e" if "FUSED" in q else "#9aa5b1" for q in cc["query"]])
axes[1].set_yticks(np.arange(len(cc))); axes[1].set_yticklabels([q.replace(" FUSED"," [fused]") for q in cc["query"]],fontsize=7.5)
axes[1].set_xscale("log"); axes[1].set_xlabel("UniProtKB entries (log scale)")
axes[1].set_title("Single polypeptides carrying two subunits' Pfam domains",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for i,(q,n) in enumerate(zip(cc["query"],cc.n_entries)): axes[1].text(n*1.15,i,str(n),va="center",fontsize=7.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
